all_words.explanation: A dissertation is an extended academic document that develops a thesis, so the two terms are closely linked.
A spatula is a kitchen utensil and has no connection to academic argument or research.
A thesis is supported by argument, so the two words belong to the same theme of academic reasoning.
A toucan is a tropical bird and is unrelated to academic writing or argument.
A proposition is a statement put forward for consideration, which is essentially what a thesis is.
A gondola is a flat-bottomed boat used on Venetian canals and has no link to academic thesis work.

explanation: Dissertation, argument and proposition are linked to the idea of a thesis, while spatula, toucan and gondola have no connection to it.
